name: Abdul El-Sayed
strip: Senator-elect · Wayne County health director 2023–2025 · Detroit health director 2015–2017

ability.name: Rhodes Scholar MD
ability.text: Doctor and public health official who ran Detroit's health department. Will be the first Muslim U.S. senator.

attacks.name: AI Under Democracy
attacks.text: June 2026: the public takes an ownership stake in the biggest AI companies, regulated like public utilities.

attacks.name: AI Under Control
attacks.text: Oct. 2026 plan: ban superintelligence, pause frontier AI, and create a Cabinet-level AI watchdog and AI safety emergency plan.

flavor: Warns of “the growing existential risks of unrestrained artificial intelligence to humanity.”
scene: a stethoscope around his neck over his suit, pressing a big glowing PAUSE button (two vertical bars) on a control console while a towering friendly robot made of light behind him freezes in place; the Detroit skyline and Renaissance Center at dusk

name: Chuck Schumer
strip: Democratic Leader · Rules · Intelligence (ex officio) · House 1981–1999, Senate since 1999

ability.name: Floor Barrage
ability.text: Gave four AI floor speeches in Sept 2026 attacking Trump's hands-off stance.

attacks.name: Classified Briefing
attacks.text: Sep 2026: called for a classified briefing for the whole Senate on catastrophic AI risks.

attacks.name: Insight Forums
attacks.text: Convened nine all-Senate AI Insight Forums from Sep 2023, then a bipartisan Senate AI roadmap in May 2024.

flavor: Brooklyn native, in Congress since 1981. Now warns of catastrophic AI risk: “The world is in danger.”
